display_long_description:
Prepare for an intense VR alien invasion!

Step into the battlefield and fight against waves of deadly aliens in an action-packed VR shooting experience. Defend your position, clear dangerous rooms, unlock powerful weapons, and see how long you can survive.

🔥 SURVIVE ALIEN WAVES
Face increasingly challenging waves of aliens. Every wave brings a new challenge, so stay alert and keep your weapons ready.

🔫 UNLOCK POWERFUL WEAPONS
Build your arsenal and unlock powerful weapons, including machine guns and other devastating firearms. Choose your weapon and fight your way through the invasion.

🏠 UNLOCK NEW ROOMS
Progress through the game by unlocking new rooms and areas. Each room brings new opportunities to fight, survive, and push your limits.

👽 FACE DEADLY ALIENS
Fight waves of hostile alien enemies and defend yourself from the invasion. Improve your skills and become a better VR shooter with every battle.

🎯 VR SHOOTING ACTION
Experience immersive first-person shooting designed for VR. Aim, shoot, reload, and react quickly as aliens attack from different directions.

🏆 PROGRESS & SURVIVE
Keep advancing through increasingly difficult levels, unlock new content, and challenge yourself to survive as long as possible.

Are you ready to defend humanity?
